name: zrndr_span_masked_16_from_pal8_to565
description: zRndr::SpanMasked16FromPal8To565 samples 8-bit paletted texture data into a 5:6:5 destination span with transparent texel and constant-alpha gates.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification currently fails after restoring the do-style inlined loop body: original 0x49c020 is 293 bytes, the compiled body is 288 bytes, 40 relocation bytes are masked, and 110 unmasked byte mismatches remain.
The remaining tier S blocker is codegen shape drift in partial-alpha channel-math register ordering and loop-tail scheduling around the generic V-shift pal8 565 loop.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49c020 validates the generic V-shift loop, source index construction from texU >> 20 plus masked texV shifted by texVShift, byte reads from g_spanActiveTexels, destination advancement by one 16-bit pixel, and texU/texV step advancement.
The original skips writes for source texel 0 and for g_spanActiveConstAlphaBits <= 3; alpha values >= 252 write g_spanActiveTexPalette[sourceIndex] directly to the 5:6:5 destination.
The partial-alpha path uses the current 5:6:5 destination word as the g_spanActiveTexPalette index, then blends red, green, and blue channel deltas by g_spanActiveConstAlphaBits.

The native smoke verifies transparent texel preservation, high-alpha palette copy, partial-alpha interpolation through palette[dst565], alpha <= 3 skip, and that g_spanCurrentDst16 is not advanced by the source-faithful implementation.
vc5_attempt: python tools/recoil.py verify vc5 0x49c020 failed under vc5_o2_ob0_md_facs with 110 unmasked mismatches after 40 relocation-masked bytes; BN size is 293 and VC5 size is 288. Evidence: build/vc5-verify/zrndr_span_masked_16_from_pal8_to565/verify/49c020_byte_diff.txt and 49c020_asm_classified_diff.txt. Restoring BN's do-style loop, cached active texture/palette/alpha globals, unsigned V-shift, and unsigned alpha gates improved the compare from the prior 243-mismatch baseline; behavior target still passes.
